result.title: DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
result.summary: Flow-based diffusion models have become a mainstream paradigm for text-to-image generation, where task-specific post-training produces specialist models with complementary strengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) offers an efficient way to consolidate these specialists into a single unified student. Recent methods strengthen supervision through teacher extrapolation, constructing stronger proxy teachers that allow distilled students to surpass the original specialists. However, their extrapolation directions remain defined solely by frozen teacher and reference models, leaving the student's own training progress unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce DexOPD, a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method for diffusion models. DexOPD retains extrapolated teacher supervision while leveraging a lagging historical student as the reference for student self-extrapolation. Sampling across multiple self-extrapolation gains from shared initial noise broadens exploration along the student's evolving trajectory, and task rewards convert pairwise differences in candidate quality into a normalized auxiliary regression direction. Empirically, we evaluate DexOPD on GenEval, OCR, and DrawBench. The resulting unified SD3.5-Medium student achieves a GenEval reward of 0.9736, an OCR score of 0.9515, and a DrawBench Aesthetic score of 6.4875, surpassing the corresponding specialist teachers as well as all evaluated OPD and multi-task reinforcement learning baselines across these three benchmarks while preserving standard single-model inference.

AI.brief_summary: 面向文生图扩散模型的多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，在教师外推之外引入滞后历史学生作为参照进行自外推，并把候选样本的任务奖励差转成归一化辅助回归方向，将多个专才合并为统一学生。
AI.relevance_reason: 用滞后学生作参照的自外推与成对奖励回归，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与状态更新设计；但该文面向图像生成，与视觉推理仅有间接方法线索。
